rule: A quick fix is offered only when it preserves evaluation order, coldness, types, comments, and declaration output
original: export const target = n => ({ onSome: Effect.succeed });
emitted: export const target = n => n ? ({ onSome: value => Effect.succeed(value) }) : ({ onSome: value => Effect.succeed(value) });
pattern: Returning a record of Effect callbacks does not establish that the returned record is an Effect.
